meta.note: Community-compiled reference data. Upcoming release dates and shelved projects are subject to change — double-check before relying on them.
meta.boxOfficeSource: TMDB revenue with The Numbers fallback

lines.name: MCU Mainline
lines.description: The core shared continuity, from Iron Man (2008) to the present Multiverse Saga.

lines.name: Marvel Television
lines.description: Marvel's live-action television era across ABC, Netflix, Hulu, and Freeform.

lines.name: Marvel on Disney+
lines.description: Marvel Studios series and animation created for Disney+.

lines.name: X-Men Line
lines.description: Fox's mutant saga (2000–2020), later folded into the MCU multiverse.

lines.name: Spider-Man (Sony)
lines.description: Two standalone Spider-Man continuities that existed before Peter Parker joined the MCU.

lines.name: Spider-Verse (Animated)
lines.description: Miles Morales' Oscar-winning animated multiverse, running parallel to live action.

lines.name: Sony's Spider-Man Universe
lines.description: Venom and other Spider-adjacent characters, mostly kept outside the MCU.

lines.name: Classic Marvel (Pre-MCU)
lines.description: Marvel adaptations that predate the shared-universe era entirely.

Amazing Spider-Man universe crosses into the MCU

movies.title: Iron Man
movies.synopsis: Billionaire engineer Tony Stark builds a powered suit of armor after a near-fatal capture, kicking off the modern superhero era.

movies.title: The Incredible Hulk
movies.synopsis: Bruce Banner evades the military while searching for a cure to the gamma radiation that turns him into a rampaging green giant.

movies.title: Iron Man 2
movies.synopsis: Tony Stark battles palladium poisoning, a vengeful rival engineer, and government pressure to hand over his armor technology.

movies.title: Thor
movies.synopsis: A brash Asgardian prince is banished to Earth without his powers and must learn humility before reclaiming his hammer.

movies.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
movies.synopsis: A frail volunteer becomes a super-soldier and leads the fight against a Nazi splinter group during World War II.

movies.title: The Avengers
movies.synopsis: Earth's mightiest heroes assemble for the first time to stop Loki and an alien army from conquering the planet.

movies.title: Iron Man 3
movies.synopsis: Tony Stark confronts a terrorist mastermind and his own anxiety after the Battle of New York, largely without his usual armor.

movies.title: Thor: The Dark World
movies.synopsis: Thor teams with Loki to stop the ancient Dark Elf Malekith from plunging the universe into darkness.

movies.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
movies.synopsis: Steve Rogers uncovers a conspiracy inside S.H.I.E.L.D. while facing a brainwashed assassin from his past.

movies.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
movies.synopsis: A ragtag crew of misfits and outlaws bands together to stop a fanatic from destroying a planet with a powerful orb.

movies.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
movies.synopsis: Tony Stark's peacekeeping AI turns hostile, forcing the Avengers to confront a synthetic threat of their own making.

movies.title: Ant-Man
movies.synopsis: A cat burglar dons a size-shifting suit to pull off a heist that could save the world.

movies.title: Captain America: Civil War
movies.synopsis: The Avengers fracture into opposing factions over a government proposal to regulate superhuman activity.

movies.title: Doctor Strange
movies.synopsis: A brilliant but arrogant surgeon learns the mystic arts after a car crash ends his career.

movies.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
movies.synopsis: The Guardians uncover Star-Lord's mysterious parentage while battling a new threat to their newfound family.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
movies.synopsis: A teenage Peter Parker balances high school with his new life as Spider-Man under Tony Stark's mentorship.

movies.title: Thor: Ragnarok
movies.synopsis: Thor is stripped of his hammer and thrown into gladiatorial combat as Asgard faces destruction from his estranged sister.

movies.title: Black Panther
movies.synopsis: T'Challa returns home to Wakanda to claim the throne, only to face a challenger with a personal claim to it.

movies.title: Avengers: Infinity War
movies.synopsis: Thanos hunts down the six Infinity Stones while the Avengers scramble to stop him across the galaxy.

movies.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
movies.synopsis: Scott Lang teams with Hope van Dyne to rescue her mother from the quantum realm.

movies.title: Captain Marvel
movies.synopsis: A former Air Force pilot discovers her cosmic powers and true origins amid a war between two alien races.

movies.title: Avengers: Endgame
movies.synopsis: The surviving Avengers attempt a time heist to undo Thanos's snap and restore half of all life.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
movies.synopsis: Peter Parker faces elemental monsters, and a mysterious hero named Mysterio, while on a school trip to Europe.

movies.title: Black Widow
movies.synopsis: Natasha Romanoff reckons with her past in the Red Room while reuniting with her estranged spy family.

movies.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
movies.synopsis: A man trained since childhood as an assassin confronts his father, the leader of a powerful crime organization.

movies.title: Eternals
movies.synopsis: A group of ancient immortal aliens reunites to protect Earth from the monstrous Deviants after millennia in hiding.

movies.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
movies.synopsis: Peter Parker's identity reveal spirals into a multiversal crisis, pulling in villains from other Spider-Man realities.

movies.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
movies.synopsis: Doctor Strange journeys across alternate universes with Wanda Maximoff on his trail as she seeks a way to reclaim her lost children.

movies.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
movies.synopsis: Thor teams with his ex, Jane Foster — now wielding Mjolnir herself — to stop a god-killer named Gorr.

movies.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
movies.synopsis: Wakanda must protect itself from a new underwater nation after the loss of its king.

movies.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
movies.synopsis: The Lang and van Dyne family are pulled into the quantum realm and face the time-conquering warlord Kang.

movies.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
movies.synopsis: The Guardians risk everything to save Rocket from his dark origins at the hands of a genetic engineer.

movies.title: The Marvels
movies.synopsis: Carol Danvers, Kamala Khan, and Monica Rambeau find their powers entangled and must team up to stop a Kree revolutionary.

movies.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
movies.synopsis: A restless Wade Wilson recruits a reluctant Wolverine variant to save his universe, formally folding Fox's X-Men into the MCU multiverse.

movies.title: Captain America: Brave New World
movies.synopsis: Sam Wilson's first outing as Captain America is complicated by a new U.S. president with a dangerous secret.

movies.title: Thunderbolts*
movies.synopsis: A team of morally gray anti-heroes is thrown together on a mission and forced to become an uneasy new Avengers.

movies.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
movies.synopsis: Marvel's First Family debuts in a retro-futuristic world, defending Earth from the herald of a cosmic devourer.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
movies.synopsis: In the fallout of No Way Home's reality-altering ending, Peter Parker rebuilds his life and reputation without the world knowing who he is. A grounded, character-driven story widely hailed as the most mature of the MCU Spider-Man films, it became the highest-grossing movie of 2026.

movies.title: Avengers: Doomsday
movies.synopsis: The Avengers face a new, world-altering threat tied to Victor von Doom, in the Russo brothers' return to the franchise.

movies.title: Avengers: Secret Wars
movies.synopsis: The Multiverse Saga reaches its climax as realities collide in the MCU's next mega-crossover event.

movies.title: Blade
movies.synopsis: A planned reboot starring Mahershala Ali as the vampire hunter Blade. Development has stalled repeatedly with no confirmed release plan.

movies.title: X-Men
movies.synopsis: Two mutants with opposing philosophies, Professor X and Magneto, clash over how humanity should respond to a rising mutant population.

movies.title: X2: X-Men United
movies.synopsis: The X-Men and Magneto form an uneasy alliance to stop a military scientist bent on eradicating mutantkind.

movies.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
movies.synopsis: A so-called mutant "cure" divides the X-Men as Jean Grey's darker Phoenix persona resurfaces.

movies.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
movies.synopsis: Logan's brutal past is revealed, from his earliest years to the experiment that fused adamantium to his skeleton.

movies.title: X-Men: First Class
movies.synopsis: A young Charles Xavier and Erik Lehnsherr recruit the first class of mutants during the Cuban Missile Crisis.

movies.title: The Wolverine
movies.synopsis: Logan travels to Japan, where an old friend's dying wish leads him into a web of family betrayal and mortality.

movies.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
movies.synopsis: Wolverine's consciousness is sent back to 1973 to prevent an assassination that leads to a dystopian future.

movies.title: Deadpool
movies.synopsis: A wisecracking mercenary gains regenerative powers and sets out for revenge against the man who disfigured him.

movies.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
movies.synopsis: The X-Men must stop history's first mutant, an ancient god-like being, from wiping out modern civilization.

movies.title: Logan
movies.synopsis: An aging, ailing Wolverine cares for a dying Professor X while protecting a young mutant girl from a shadowy corporation.

movies.title: Deadpool 2
movies.synopsis: Deadpool assembles a team of mutants to protect a troubled young boy from a time-traveling soldier.

movies.title: Dark Phoenix
movies.synopsis: Jean Grey's powers spiral out of control after a space rescue mission exposes her to a cosmic force.

movies.title: The New Mutants
movies.synopsis: Five young mutants are held in a secret facility where they must confront supernatural manifestations of their pasts.

movies.title: Spider-Man
movies.synopsis: High schooler Peter Parker gains spider-powers and battles his mentor's alter ego, the Green Goblin.

movies.title: Spider-Man 2
movies.synopsis: Peter Parker struggles to balance his personal life with his responsibilities as Spider-Man while facing the fused scientist Doctor Octopus.

movies.title: Spider-Man 3
movies.synopsis: Peter Parker contends with a symbiotic alien substance, a new love rival, and the man who really killed his uncle.

movies.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
movies.synopsis: A rebooted Peter Parker investigates his parents' disappearance while facing a reptilian scientist at Oscorp.

movies.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
movies.synopsis: Spider-Man faces the electrically-charged Electro while his relationship with Gwen Stacy heads toward tragedy.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
movies.synopsis: Teenager Miles Morales becomes his universe's Spider-Man and meets alternate-reality Spider-People pulled together by a dimension-hopping collider.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
movies.synopsis: Miles Morales journeys across a vast multiverse of Spider-People, only to clash with them over the rules that define a Spider-Man's story.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse
movies.synopsis: The concluding chapter of Miles Morales's saga, picking up directly after the cliffhanger ending of Across the Spider-Verse.

movies.title: Venom
movies.synopsis: Investigative journalist Eddie Brock bonds with an alien symbiote that grants him violent powers and a voracious appetite.

movies.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
movies.synopsis: Eddie Brock and Venom face off against serial killer Cletus Kasady, who bonds with a symbiote of his own.

movies.title: Morbius
movies.synopsis: A biochemist suffering from a rare blood disease attempts a cure that instead turns him into a vampire-like creature.

movies.title: Madame Web
movies.synopsis: A paramedic with newfound precognitive visions tries to protect three young women from a killer chasing their shared destiny.

movies.title: Kraven the Hunter
movies.synopsis: Sergei Kravinoff transforms himself into humanity's greatest hunter, driven by a personal vendetta and a taste for dangerous prey.

movies.title: Venom: The Last Dance
movies.synopsis: Eddie Brock and Venom go on the run as forces from both Earth and the symbiote homeworld close in.

movies.title: Blade
movies.synopsis: A half-vampire hunter wages a one-man war against the vampire underworld to prevent an ancient blood god's rise.

movies.title: Blade II
movies.synopsis: Blade forges an uneasy truce with vampires to fight a new mutant strain of bloodsuckers that threatens them both.

movies.title: Daredevil
movies.synopsis: Blind lawyer Matt Murdock uses his heightened senses to fight crime at night as the vigilante Daredevil.

movies.title: Hulk
movies.synopsis: Genetic researcher Bruce Banner transforms into a giant, rage-fueled creature after a lab accident awakens his father's experiments.

movies.title: The Punisher
movies.synopsis: Ex-special-forces agent Frank Castle becomes a vigilante after his family is murdered by a crime boss's son.

movies.title: Blade: Trinity
movies.synopsis: Blade is hunted by both humans and vampires while facing the original vampire, Dracula, revived in the modern day.

movies.title: Elektra
movies.synopsis: Assassin Elektra Natchios is resurrected and hired to protect a father and daughter from a supernatural crime organization.

movies.title: Fantastic Four
movies.synopsis: Four astronauts gain extraordinary powers after exposure to cosmic radiation and must stop a former colleague turned villain.

movies.title: Ghost Rider
movies.synopsis: Stunt motorcyclist Johnny Blaze sells his soul and becomes a flame-skulled bounty hunter of evil souls.

movies.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
movies.synopsis: The Fantastic Four face a herald of a planet-devouring cosmic entity while Reed and Sue plan their wedding.

movies.title: Ghost Rider: Spirit of Vengeance
movies.synopsis: Johnny Blaze is recruited by a secret sect to protect a boy who is being hunted for his powerful bloodline.

movies.title: Fantastic Four
movies.synopsis: A young team of scientists gains powers after a teleportation experiment to a parallel dimension goes wrong.

movies.title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. — Season 1
movies.creator: Joss Whedon, Jed Whedon, Maurissa Tancharoen
movies.director: Joss Whedon, Jed Whedon, Maurissa Tancharoen
movies.synopsis: Season one begins where the “Marvel's The Avengers” left off. It's just after the battle of New York, and now that the existence of superheroes and aliens has become public knowledge, the world is trying to come to grips with this new reality. Agent Phil Coulson is back in action and now has his eye on a mysterious group called The Rising Tide. In order to track this unseen, unknown enemy, he has assembled a small, highly select group of Agents from the worldwide law-enforcement organization known as S.H.I.E.L.D.

movies.title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. — Season 2
movies.creator: Joss Whedon, Jed Whedon, Maurissa Tancharoen
movies.director: Joss Whedon, Jed Whedon, Maurissa Tancharoen
movies.synopsis: In the second season, Coulson and his team look to restore trust from the government and public following S.H.I.E.L.D.'s collapse.

movies.title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. — Season 3
movies.creator: Joss Whedon, Jed Whedon, Maurissa Tancharoen
movies.director: Joss Whedon, Jed Whedon, Maurissa Tancharoen
movies.synopsis: Many months after their war with a rogue group of Inhumans, the team is still reeling. Coulson is again trying to put the pieces of his once revered organization back together while also dealing with the loss of his hand. His confidante and second in command, Agent Melinda May, has yet to return from an impromptu vacation with ex-husband Andrew; deadly superspy Agent Bobbi Morse is recovering from her traumatic torture at the hands of Grant Ward; Fitz is obsessed with discovering the truth behind the mysterious disappearance of Simmons; and all are on high-alert for the next move from Ward and Hydra.

movies.title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. — Season 4
movies.creator: Joss Whedon, Jed Whedon, Maurissa Tancharoen
movies.director: Joss Whedon, Jed Whedon, Maurissa Tancharoen
movies.synopsis: Vengeance runs rampant this season as Coulson is a mere agent again, and Daisy has gone rogue after being under Hive's control. How will S.H.I.E.L.D. deal with the arrival of The Ghost Rider?

movies.title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. — Season 5
movies.creator: Joss Whedon, Jed Whedon, Maurissa Tancharoen
movies.director: Joss Whedon, Jed Whedon, Maurissa Tancharoen
movies.synopsis: Agent Coulson and the team escaped LMD Aida’s Framework and awakened in the real world. Little did they know that Aida was now fully human – and with multiple Inhuman abilities – with the dangerous notion that, with Fitz by her side, she could change the world. After defeating her with the aid of Ghost Rider, the team went out for a celebration but were interrupted by a mysterious man who rendered them frozen. The next thing we see is Coulson onboard a ship … in space. Coulson will discover that some, but not all, of his S.H.I.E.L.D. colleagues were taken with him and placed onboard the ship. As they come in contact with some of the vessel’s inhabitants, it becomes abundantly clear that something has gone terribly awry, and the team will need to figure out their role and delve deeper into this nightmarish mystery to try to right what has gone incredibly wrong.

movies.title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. — Season 6
movies.creator: Joss Whedon, Jed Whedon, Maurissa Tancharoen
movies.director: Joss Whedon, Jed Whedon, Maurissa Tancharoen
movies.synopsis: Last season, the team leaped forward in time to a dystopian future they soon realized must be prevented. While facing multiple timelines and new enemies from faraway planets, they found family, friends, teammates and the courage to pull off their biggest challenge yet. Their next challenge? Coming to grips with the knowledge that bending the laws of space and time may have saved the planet, but it couldn’t save Fitz or Coulson.

movies.title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. — Season 7
movies.creator: Joss Whedon, Jed Whedon, Maurissa Tancharoen
movies.director: Joss Whedon, Jed Whedon, Maurissa Tancharoen
movies.synopsis: Coulson and the Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. are thrust backward in time and stranded in 1931 New York City. With the all-new Zephyr set to time-jump at any moment, the team must hurry to find out exactly what happened. If they fail, it would mean disaster for the past, present and future of the world.

movies.title: Marvel's Agent Carter — Season 1
movies.creator: Stephen McFeely, Christopher Markus
movies.synopsis: Years before Agent Phil Coulson and his S.H.I.E.L.D. team swore to protect those who cannot protect themselves from threats they cannot conceive, there was Agent Peggy Carter, who pledged the same oath but lived in a different time, when women weren't recognized as being as smart or as tough as their male counterparts. But no one should ever underestimate Peggy.

movies.title: Marvel's Agent Carter — Season 2
movies.creator: Stephen McFeely, Christopher Markus
movies.synopsis: Dedicated to the fight against new Atomic Age threats in the wake of World War II, Peggy must now journey from New York City to Los Angeles and she's about to find out that the bright lights of the post-war Hollywood mask a more sinister threat to everyone she is sworn to protect.

movies.title: Marvel's Daredevil — Season 1
movies.creator: Drew Goddard
movies.synopsis: Blinded as a young boy, Matt Murdock fights injustice by day as a lawyer and by night as the superhero Daredevil in Hell's Kitchen, New York City.

movies.title: Marvel's Daredevil — Season 2
movies.creator: Drew Goddard
movies.synopsis: Dark forces are tearing Hell's Kitchen apart once again, but this time Daredevil may have to choose between the city and his friends.

movies.title: Marvel's Daredevil — Season 3
movies.creator: Drew Goddard
movies.synopsis: Missing for months, Matt Murdock reemerges a broken man, putting into question his future as both vigilante Daredevil and lawyer Matthew Murdock. But when his archenemy Wilson Fisk is released from prison, Matt must choose between hiding from the world, or embracing his destiny as a hero.

movies.title: Marvel's Jessica Jones — Season 1
movies.creator: Melissa Rosenberg
movies.synopsis: Haunted by a traumatic past, Jessica Jones uses her gifts as a private eye to find her tormentor before he can harm anyone else in Hell's Kitchen.

movies.title: Marvel's Jessica Jones — Season 2
movies.creator: Melissa Rosenberg
movies.synopsis: Drowning in anger, Jessica Jones is forced to reckon with her past, her powers and her newfound fame as she dishes out her own messy form of justice. Finally ready to face her past, Jessica hunts down the source of her powers and uncovers a link to a shadowy killer who's terrorizing the city.

movies.title: Marvel's Jessica Jones — Season 3
movies.creator: Melissa Rosenberg
movies.synopsis: Jessica matches wits with a calculating serial killer, and a newly powered Trish goes to extremes to stamp out evil.

movies.title: Marvel's Luke Cage — Season 1
movies.creator: Cheo Hodari Coker
movies.synopsis: As the bulletproof defender of Harlem, Luke Cage battles corrupt politicians, ruthless gangsters and demons from his own past.

movies.title: Marvel's Luke Cage — Season 2
movies.creator: Cheo Hodari Coker
movies.synopsis: As his fame and responsibility soar, Luke Cage finds his life upended by a mysterious newcomer with powers of his own -- and a plan to take over Harlem.

movies.title: Marvel's Iron Fist — Season 1
movies.creator: Scott Buck
movies.synopsis: Fifteen years after being presumed dead in a plane crash, Danny Rand mysteriously returns to New York City determined to reclaim his birthright and family company. However, when a long-destined enemy rises in New York, this living weapon is forced to choose between his family’s legacy and his duties as the Iron Fist.

movies.title: Marvel's Iron Fist — Season 2
movies.creator: Scott Buck
movies.synopsis: As a gang war brews in New York's Chinatown, Danny and Colleen strive to protect the innocent while battling fearsome enemies both old and new.

movies.title: Marvel's The Defenders — Season 1
movies.creator: Douglas Petrie, Marco Ramirez
movies.synopsis: Daredevil, Jessica Jones, Luke Cage and Iron Fist join forces to take on common enemies as a sinister conspiracy threatens New York City.

movies.title: Marvel's Inhumans — Season 1
movies.creator: Scott Buck
movies.synopsis: After the Royal Family of Inhumans is splintered by a military coup, they barely escape to Hawaii where their surprising interactions with the lush world and humanity around them may prove to not only save them, but Earth itself.

movies.title: Marvel's The Punisher — Season 1
movies.creator: Steve Lightfoot
movies.synopsis: A former Marine out to punish the criminals responsible for his family's murder finds himself ensnared in a military conspiracy.

movies.title: Marvel's The Punisher — Season 2
movies.creator: Steve Lightfoot
movies.synopsis: Frank strives to protect a teenager caught in a sinister conspiracy while doing whatever it takes -- and then some -- to end Russo once and for all.

movies.title: Marvel's Runaways — Season 1
movies.creator: Josh Schwartz, Stephanie Savage
movies.synopsis: Every teenager thinks their parents are evil. What if you found out they actually were? Six diverse teenagers who can barely stand each other must unite against a common foe – their parents.

movies.title: Marvel's Runaways — Season 2
movies.creator: Josh Schwartz, Stephanie Savage
movies.synopsis: The Runaways have left their homes (and evil parents) behind and now have to learn to live on their own. As they scavenge for food, search for shelter, and take care of one another, our kids begin to realize that, for better or worse, they’re stuck with each other. And it’s up to them to take down PRIDE once and for all. But someone sent a mysterious message to Jonah… Is there a mole in the Runaways? Meanwhile PRIDE is focused on finding their children, and Jonah has his own dangerous plan in mind.

movies.title: Marvel's Runaways — Season 3
movies.creator: Josh Schwartz, Stephanie Savage
movies.synopsis: The Runaways frantically search for their captured friends Chase, Gert and Karolina. The kids go head to head with an unstoppable enemy who has targeted Leslie - or more accurately, the child she's carrying. Nico draws them all into a dark realm where its ruler Morgan le Fay, is much more nefarious than anyone the kids have yet to face.

movies.title: Marvel's Cloak & Dagger — Season 1
movies.creator: Joe Pokaski
movies.synopsis: Two teenagers from very different backgrounds awaken to newly acquired superpowers which mysteriously link them to one another.

movies.title: Marvel's Cloak & Dagger — Season 2
movies.creator: Joe Pokaski
movies.synopsis: Season two turns the heat up on our young heroes as Tyrone and Tandy try to find their place as more active heroes in this world. As they learn and grow emotionally, so will their skills. With enhanced powers and a decision to make about the type of heroes they want to be, they make the choice to run into the danger, head first. They tackle a heartless vigilante and uncover an evil that’s been preying on the young women of the city, as the show takes on more serious topics like gang violence and human trafficking.

movies.title: Helstrom — Season 1
movies.creator: Paul Zbyszewski
movies.synopsis: Daimon and Ana Helstrom are the son and daughter of a mysterious and powerful serial killer. The siblings have a complicated dynamic as they track down the terrorizing worst of humanity — each with their attitude and skills.

movies.title: WandaVision — Season 1
movies.creator: Jac Schaeffer
movies.synopsis: Wanda Maximoff and Vision—two super-powered beings living idealized suburban lives—begin to suspect that everything is not as it seems.

movies.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier — Season 1
movies.seriesTitle: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
movies.creator: Malcolm Spellman
movies.synopsis: Following the events of “Avengers: Endgame”, the Falcon, Sam Wilson and the Winter Soldier, Bucky Barnes team up in a global adventure that tests their abilities, and their patience.

movies.title: Loki — Season 1
movies.creator: Michael Waldron
movies.synopsis: Loki, the God of Mischief, steps out of his brother's shadow to embark on an adventure that takes place after the events of "Avengers: Endgame."

movies.title: Loki — Season 2
movies.creator: Michael Waldron
movies.synopsis: In the aftermath of Season 1, Loki finds himself in a battle for the soul of the Time Variance Authority. Along with Mobius, Hunter B-15 and a team of new and returning characters, Loki navigates an ever-expanding and increasingly dangerous multiverse in search of Sylvie, Judge Renslayer, Miss Minutes and the truth of what it means to possess free will and glorious purpose.

movies.title: What If...? — Season 1
movies.creator: Marvel Television
movies.synopsis: Taking inspiration from the comic books of the same name, each episode of this animated anthology series questions, revisits and twists classic Marvel Cinematic moments.

movies.title: What If...? — Season 2
movies.creator: Marvel Television
movies.synopsis: Season two continues the journey as The Watcher guides viewers through the vast multiverse, introducing brand new and familiar faces throughout the MCU.

movies.title: What If...? — Season 3
movies.creator: Marvel Television
movies.synopsis: Season 3 follows classic characters as they make unexpected choices that will mutate their worlds into spectacular alternate versions of the MCU.

movies.title: Hawkeye — Season 1
movies.creator: Jonathan Igla
movies.synopsis: Former Avenger Clint Barton has a seemingly simple mission: get back to his family for Christmas. Possible? Maybe with the help of Kate Bishop, a 22-year-old archer with dreams of becoming a superhero. The two are forced to work together when a presence from Barton’s past threatens to derail far more than the festive spirit.

movies.title: Moon Knight — Season 1
movies.creator: Jeremy Slater
movies.synopsis: When Steven Grant, a mild-mannered gift-shop employee, becomes plagued with blackouts and memories of another life, he discovers he has dissociative identity disorder and shares a body with mercenary Marc Spector. As Steven/Marc’s enemies converge upon them, they must navigate their complex identities while thrust into a deadly mystery among the powerful gods of Egypt.

movies.title: Ms. Marvel — Season 1
movies.creator: Bisha K. Ali
movies.synopsis: A great student, avid gamer, and voracious fan-fic scribe, Kamala Khan has a special affinity for superheroes, particularly Captain Marvel. However, she struggles to fit in at home and at school — that is, until she gets superpowers like the heroes she’s always looked up to. Life is easier with superpowers, right?

movies.title: I Am Groot — Season 1
movies.creator: Marvel Television
movies.synopsis: Marvel Studios’ “I Am Groot” is a collection of five original shorts starring Baby Groot, everyone’s favorite little tree, and features several new and unusual characters.

movies.title: I Am Groot — Season 2
movies.creator: Marvel Television
movies.synopsis: The troublemaking twig returns to mischief in the second season of “I Am Groot.” This time, Baby Groot finds himself exploring the universe and beyond aboard the Guardians' spaceships, coming face-to-face—or nose-to-nose—with new and colorful creatures and environments.

movies.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law — Season 1
movies.creator: Jessica Gao
movies.synopsis: Jennifer Walters navigates the complicated life of a single, 30-something attorney who also happens to be a green 6-foot-7-inch superpowered hulk.

movies.title: Secret Invasion — Season 1
movies.creator: Kyle Bradstreet
movies.synopsis: Nick Fury and Talos discover a faction of shapeshifting Skrulls who have been infiltrating Earth for years.

movies.title: Echo — Season 1
movies.creator: Marvel Television
movies.synopsis: Pursued by Wilson Fisk's criminal empire, Maya's journey brings her home and she must confront her own family and legacy.

movies.title: X-Men '97 — Season 1
movies.creator: Marvel Television
movies.synopsis: Picking up where 'X-Men' left off, the X-Men are in a period of transition, struggling with the loss of Professor X. And while their world is in a strained state of calm when it comes to mutant-human relations—everyone knows that's likely temporary.

movies.title: X-Men '97 — Season 2
movies.creator: Marvel Television
movies.synopsis: Season 2 continues with the heroic mutant team of X-Men, divided and thrown across different eras in time as they struggle to navigate their return home. Meanwhile, back in the 1990s, suspicious foes and new strains of mutant intolerance are on the rise in the wake of the X-Men's absence.

movies.title: Agatha All Along — Season 1
movies.creator: Jac Schaeffer
movies.synopsis: The infamous Agatha Harkness finds herself down and out of power after a suspicious goth Teen helps break her free from a distorted spell. Her interest is piqued when he begs her to take him on the legendary Witches' Road, a magical gauntlet of trials that, if survived, rewards a witch with what they're missing. Together, Agatha and this mysterious Teen pull together a desperate coven, and set off down, down, down the Road...

movies.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man — Season 1
movies.creator: Marvel Television
movies.synopsis: Peter Parker is on his way to becoming a hero, but his path to get there is anything but ordinary.

movies.title: Daredevil: Born Again — Season 1
movies.creator: Dario Scardapane, Chris Ord, Matt Corman
movies.director: Dario Scardapane, Chris Ord, Matt Corman
movies.synopsis: It has been a year since Matt Murdock retired from crime fighting as Daredevil. Wilson Fisk has been elected mayor of New York City after running on an anti-vigilante platform. The Kingpin may force Daredevil to come out of retirement.

movies.title: Daredevil: Born Again — Season 2
movies.creator: Dario Scardapane, Chris Ord, Matt Corman
movies.director: Dario Scardapane, Chris Ord, Matt Corman
movies.synopsis: Mayor Wilson Fisk crushes New York City underfoot as he hunts down public enemy number one, the Hell's Kitchen vigilante known as Daredevil. But beneath the horned mask, Matt Murdock will try to fight back from the shadows to tear down the Kingpin's corrupt empire and redeem his home. Resist. Rebel. Rebuild.

movies.title: Ironheart — Season 1
movies.creator: Chinaka Hodge
movies.synopsis: After the events of Black Panther: Wakanda Forever, technology is pitted against magic when Riri Williams, a young, genius inventor determined to make her mark on the world, returns to her hometown of Chicago. Her unique take on building iron suits is brilliant, but in pursuit of her ambitions, she finds herself wrapped up with the mysterious yet charming Parker Robbins aka "The Hood."

movies.title: Eyes of Wakanda — Season 1
movies.creator: Marvel Television
movies.synopsis: Follow the adventures of brave Wakandan warriors throughout history in this globe-trotting adventure, where they must carry out dangerous missions to retrieve Vibranium artifacts from the enemies of Wakanda. They are the Hatut Zaraze and this is their story.

movies.title: Marvel Zombies — Season 1
movies.creator: Marvel Television
movies.synopsis: After the Avengers are overtaken by a zombie plague, a desperate group of survivors discover the key to bringing an end to the super-powered undead, racing across a dystopian landscape and risking life and limb to save their world.

movies.title: Marvel Zombies — Season 2
movies.creator: Marvel Television
movies.synopsis: After the Avengers are overtaken by a zombie plague, a desperate group of survivors discover the key to bringing an end to the super-powered undead, racing across a dystopian landscape and risking life and limb to save their world.

movies.title: Wonder Man — Season 1
movies.creator: Andrew Guest, Destin Daniel Cretton
movies.synopsis: Aspiring Hollywood actor Simon Williams is struggling to get his career off the ground. During a chance meeting with Trevor Slattery, an actor whose biggest roles may be well behind him, Simon learns that legendary director Von Kovak is remaking the superhero film "Wonder Man." These two actors at opposite ends of their careers doggedly pursue life-changing roles in this film as audiences get a peek behind the curtain of the entertainment industry.

movies.title: Wonder Man — Season 2
movies.creator: Andrew Guest, Destin Daniel Cretton
movies.synopsis: Simon and Trevor, two actors at opposite ends of their careers, chase life-changing roles.
